scope.selection: ARCHIVED receipts with expectedKind pdf or response MIME application/pdf; deduplicated by stored body SHA-256.
scope.bodyBoundary: Raw third-party bodies remain in ignored local archive. This artifact records only structural validation metadata and does not extract or commit paper text.

boundary: A successful parse establishes only that the archived bytes are structurally readable as a PDF and match the receipt digest/size. It does not validate the source claim, paper relevance, licence, rendering completeness, or scientific conclusion.
